info.title: StockAnalysis API
info.description: Factor-based equity research for Indian markets. Scores are percentiles within the scored universe on each date, not absolute valuations.

get.description: Liveness plus enough state to tell "empty" from "broken".

What the numbers mean: live weights and thresholds, not a transcription.

The factor and flag lists are read from the model's own definitions, so a
factor added in Python appears here without anyone copying it.

schema.title: Response Signal History V1 Instruments  Isin  History Get

get.description:
Why a signal is what it is: the families that carried it, the factors
for and against, the news mix, and any red flag that forced it.

Rebuilt from that date's stored factor scores, never re-scored, so it
describes the number the other routes return — see `serve.explain`. A past
date stored under another scoring config is `stale`, exactly as the latest
one would be.

parameters.name: as_of

schema.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Explain the signal stored on exactly this date; defaults to the latest. A date with no stored signal is a 404, never the nearest date's.
schema.title: As Of

parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Explain the signal stored on exactly this date; defaults to the latest. A date with no stored signal is a 404, never the nearest date's.

get.description:
Why a company is or isn't scored. 200 for any known ISIN, 404 otherwise.

`/latest` answers 404 for a company with no signal; this says which of
"never measured", "below the coverage floor" and "the filings can't be read"
it is, from what the runs stored.

Reported figures, newest first, in ₹ crore except EPS.

Every stored year comes back whatever its basis. A company that moved from
standalone to consolidated shows the move rather than losing a year, and a
client computing growth across it should say so — see
`queries.annual_financials`. Empty lists, not a 404, for a listed company
with nothing filed yet.

Daily bars, oldest first, both ends inclusive.

The default window ends at the company's latest stored day, not today, so
a chart opens on data even when prices have not been ingested for a while.

schema.title: Response List Signals V1 Signals Get

eps_adjusted.title: Eps Adjusted
eps_adjusted.description: ₹ per share: eps restated onto today's share basis — the basis of the stored price series — across every split and bonus with an ex-date after the filing (see /corporate-actions). Equal to eps when there was none; comparable across years where eps is not. Null when eps is.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: The document the figures were read from: the results filing's XBRL instance on nsearchives.nseindia.com (source XBRL), or the annual report PDF (source LLM). Null for rows stored before links were recorded.

ratio.title: Ratio
ratio.description: SPLIT and BONUS: shares after per share before (a 1:1 bonus is 2.0, a ₹10 to ₹2 split 5.0). RIGHTS: new shares offered per share held. Null for the other types.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: DIVIDEND: ₹ per share on the share basis of the ex-date, summed when one announcement pays several. Null otherwise.

details.title: Details
details.description: The exchange's own wording of the action.

sector_median.title: Sector Median
sector_median.description: Median raw_value of the company's sector that day, in its unit.

sector_n.title: Sector N
sector_n.description: Sector companies with a value that day, this one included.

sector_percentile.title: Sector Percentile
sector_percentile.description: 0-100 rank of raw_value within the sector, ascending: 100 is the highest raw value, which for a lower-is-better metric (higher_is_better false in /model) is the worst.

zscore_basis.title: Zscore Basis
zscore_basis.description: What the z-score was taken against: the sector, or the whole scored universe when fewer than five sector companies had a value (or the company has no sector). With universe the sector figures are context only.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: How to read raw_value. percent: a fraction to show as % (0.0785 is 7.85%). pp: a difference of two fractions, in percentage points (0.012 is +1.2 pp). multiple: a ratio to show as × (0.68 is 0.68×). ratio_vs_trend: price over its 200-day average (0.89 is 11% below trend). score: signed, −1 to +1. ratio: a plain number with no unit. Null for a factor the current model does not define.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Fraction (0-1) of the model's weight backed by data — weighted by family and by each factor's weight within its family, so not a share of factors (score-status gives the factor counts). Below /model.coverage_floor no score is published.

meaning.title: Meaning
meaning.description: What a positive (sign-adjusted) z-score says about the company.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: How to read raw_value. percent: a fraction to show as % (0.0785 is 7.85%). pp: a difference of two fractions, in percentage points (0.012 is +1.2 pp). multiple: a ratio to show as × (0.68 is 0.68×). ratio_vs_trend: price over its 200-day average (0.89 is 11% below trend). score: signed, −1 to +1. ratio: a plain number with no unit. Null for a factor the current model does not define.

higher_is_better.title: Higher Is Better
higher_is_better.description: Direction of the raw metric before the model's sign flip. False for debt/equity and accruals, whose z-scores are negated so that a positive z is always good.

sector_median.title: Sector Median
sector_median.description: Median raw_value of the company's sector that day, in its unit.

sector_n.title: Sector N
sector_n.description: Sector companies with a value that day, this one included.

sector_percentile.title: Sector Percentile
sector_percentile.description: 0-100 rank of raw_value within the sector, ascending: 100 is the highest raw value, which for a lower-is-better metric (higher_is_better false in /model) is the worst.

zscore_basis.title: Zscore Basis
zscore_basis.description: What the z-score was taken against: the sector, or the whole scored universe when fewer than five sector companies had a value (or the company has no sector). With universe the sector figures are context only.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: How to read raw_value. percent: a fraction to show as % (0.0785 is 7.85%). pp: a difference of two fractions, in percentage points (0.012 is +1.2 pp). multiple: a ratio to show as × (0.68 is 0.68×). ratio_vs_trend: price over its 200-day average (0.89 is 11% below trend). score: signed, −1 to +1. ratio: a plain number with no unit. Null for a factor the current model does not define.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: Share of the composite, as a fraction (0-1).

percentile.title: Percentile
percentile.description: 0-100 within the universe scored that day; null when the family was not measured.

z.title: Z
z.description: Family z, standardised across the universe so the declared weights bind.

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.description: z × weight ÷ (sum of the weights of the families measured for this company). Renormalised over the measured families, as the composite is, so the contributions sum to the composite z.

percentile.title: Percentile
percentile.description: 0-100 within the universe scored that day; null when no factor in the family was measured.

contribution.title: Contribution
contribution.description: Signed share of that day's composite z (negative pulled the score down); the families' contributions sum to it.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit of every figure except per-share ones: ₹ crore (1 crore = 10 million).

per_share_unit.title: Per Share Unit
per_share_unit.description: Unit of per-share figures (eps, eps_adjusted, and lines with per_share true): rupees per share.

latest_complete_as_of.title: Latest Complete As Of
latest_complete_as_of.description: Newest scoring date on which at least 50% of the instruments active that day got a signal. latest_as_of can be a partial run (16 Aug 2026 scored 4 of 100); this is the newest date a full list can be read from. Null when no date qualifies.

latest_price_date.title: Latest Price Date
latest_price_date.description: Newest close stored for any company. A company's own is key-metrics.as_of.

latest_filing_date.title: Latest Filing Date
latest_filing_date.description: Newest filing date of any stored quarterly or annual results, the date the figures became public.

latest_news_date.title: Latest News Date
latest_news_date.description: Newest publication date of any article attributed to a company.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Fraction (0-1) of the model's weight backed by data — weighted by family and by each factor's weight within its family, so not a share of factors (score-status gives the factor counts). Below /model.coverage_floor no score is published.

previous.description: The same instrument's most recent signal strictly before this row's as_of, whatever the rows a query returns; null for its first. A different model_version means the change is partly the model's.

families.title: Families
families.description: The day's family breakdown, replayed from that day's stored z-scores with the current model's weights — a row whose model_version differs is re-derived, as /explanation's stale flag says. Empty when the day stored no factor rows.

bse_code.title: Bse Code
bse_code.description: BSE scrip code, as the company's own results filings identify it. Null until a filing has been read.

listing_date.title: Listing Date
listing_date.description: Null: no source for it is ingested yet.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: The exchange's industry classification. For the NIFTY 100 universe today it repeats the sector.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: The close every figure is taken at; filings after it are ignored. Null when the company has no prices.

price.title: Price
price.description: Close on as_of, ₹. The stored series is split- and bonus-adjusted to the share basis it was fetched on.

shares_outstanding_cr.title: Shares Outstanding Cr
shares_outstanding_cr.description: Shares outstanding, crore, on the price basis.

share_source.title: Share Source
share_source.description: stated: paid-up capital over face value, from the newest filing that tags them. implied: PAT / EPS of the latest annual results, where no filing states the count.

shares_filing_date.title: Shares Filing Date
shares_filing_date.description: Filing date of the share count's source.

eps_ttm.title: Eps Ttm
eps_ttm.description: ₹ per share, on the price series' share basis (see restated). Sum of the four newest quarters; null unless four consecutive quarters with EPS are filed.

pe_ttm.title: Pe Ttm
pe_ttm.description: price / eps_ttm. Null when EPS is zero or negative.

ttm_through.title: Ttm Through
ttm_through.description: Period end of the newest quarter in eps_ttm.

ttm_filing_date.title: Ttm Filing Date
ttm_filing_date.description: Filing date of the newest quarter in eps_ttm.

eps_annual.title: Eps Annual
eps_annual.description: ₹ per share, on the price series' share basis (see restated). Latest annual EPS — the figure earnings_yield uses.

pe_annual.title: Pe Annual
pe_annual.description: price / eps_annual, the inverse of earnings_yield. Null when EPS is zero or negative.

annual_basis.title: Annual Basis
annual_basis.description: CONSOLIDATED where the company files it, else STANDALONE.

annual_filing_date.title: Annual Filing Date
annual_filing_date.description: Filing date of the annual results used.

book_value_per_share.title: Book Value Per Share
book_value_per_share.description: ₹ per share, on the price series' share basis (see restated). Total equity / shares; can be negative.

pb.title: Pb
pb.description: price / book_value_per_share, the inverse of book_to_price. Null when book value is zero or negative.

dividends_ttm.title: Dividends Ttm
dividends_ttm.description: ₹ per share, on the price series' share basis (see restated). Dividends with an ex-date in the year to as_of, from NSE corporate actions. Null when none were ever fetched for the company; 0 when fetched and none paid.

high_52w.title: High 52W
high_52w.description: Highest high in the year to as_of, ₹.

low_52w.title: Low 52W
low_52w.description: Lowest low in the year to as_of, ₹.

KeyMetricsOut.title: KeyMetricsOut
KeyMetricsOut.description:
Valuation on the value factors' own share count and price basis.

Taken at the newest stored close and read only from filings made by then.
`pe_annual` is 1 / earnings_yield and `pb` 1 / book_to_price, so the page
cannot contradict the score. Every per-share figure is restated onto the
share basis of the price series across splits and bonuses after its
filing. Null always means unknown or not meaningful, never zero.

per_share.title: Per Share
per_share.description: True: the line is in rupees per share (FinancialsOut.per_share_unit). False: it is in ₹ crore (FinancialsOut.unit).

LineItemOut.title: LineItemOut
LineItemOut.description: One row of the annual statement, in the order a statement is read.

version.title: Version
version.description: The current model_version. Stored signals carry their own; one that differs was scored under another configuration.

coverage_floor.title: Coverage Floor
coverage_floor.description: Fraction (0-1) of the model's weight that must be backed by data before a company is scored.

red_flags.title: Red Flags
red_flags.description: Every flag the model checks. A flag is clear only when it is in neither a signal's red_flags nor its unknown_flags.

scored_date_counts.title: Scored Date Counts
scored_date_counts.description: How many companies each date in scored_dates covered, newest first, so a partial run can be told from a full one.

relevance.title: Relevance
relevance.description: primary: the company is named in the headline of an article about it. mention: named only in the body, or one of more than three companies a roundup lists. Null when the match was not recorded.

sentiment_status.title: Sentiment Status
sentiment_status.description: scored: label and score are set. pending: the company match clears the attribution threshold and the next scoring run will score it. not_scored: the match is below the threshold (an uncertain match or a roundup), so it is never scored. A failed scoring run leaves its articles pending; the pipeline records no per-article failure.

counts_toward_sentiment.title: Counts Toward Sentiment
counts_toward_sentiment.description: Whether the 30-day news factor reads this article: scored, and its company match clears the attribution threshold. False for a roundup scored before it was demoted, though its label is shown.

eps_adjusted.title: Eps Adjusted
eps_adjusted.description: ₹ per share: eps restated onto today's share basis — the basis of the stored price series — across every split and bonus with an ex-date after the filing (see /corporate-actions). Equal to eps when there was none; comparable across years where eps is not. Null when eps is.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: From is_consolidated; null when not recorded.

total_income.title: Total Income
total_income.description: ₹ crore, as the quarter's XBRL tags it. Null where the filing does not tag it, and on rows from NSE's results comparison, which carries only revenue, PAT and EPS.

other_income.title: Other Income
other_income.description: ₹ crore, as the quarter's XBRL tags it. Null where the filing does not tag it, and on rows from NSE's results comparison, which carries only revenue, PAT and EPS.

total_expenses.title: Total Expenses
total_expenses.description: ₹ crore, as the quarter's XBRL tags it. Null where the filing does not tag it, and on rows from NSE's results comparison, which carries only revenue, PAT and EPS.

depreciation.title: Depreciation
depreciation.description: ₹ crore, as the quarter's XBRL tags it. Null where the filing does not tag it, and on rows from NSE's results comparison, which carries only revenue, PAT and EPS.

interest_expense.title: Interest Expense
interest_expense.description: ₹ crore, as the quarter's XBRL tags it. Null where the filing does not tag it, and on rows from NSE's results comparison, which carries only revenue, PAT and EPS. Finance costs; for a bank, the interest it pays, which is its main operating cost.

profit_before_tax.title: Profit Before Tax
profit_before_tax.description: ₹ crore, as the quarter's XBRL tags it. Null where the filing does not tag it, and on rows from NSE's results comparison, which carries only revenue, PAT and EPS.

tax_expense.title: Tax Expense
tax_expense.description: ₹ crore, as the quarter's XBRL tags it. Null where the filing does not tag it, and on rows from NSE's results comparison, which carries only revenue, PAT and EPS.

ebitda.title: Ebitda
ebitda.description: Derived, ₹ crore: profit_before_tax + interest_expense + depreciation, the value factor's own formula. Null for banks and insurers, and where PBT or depreciation is missing.

source_url.title: Source Url
source_url.description: The results filing's XBRL instance the figures were read from, on nsearchives.nseindia.com. Null for rows from NSE's results comparison.

reachable.title: Reachable
reachable.description: False when no data source the system ingests can evaluate the flag, so it is unknown for every company — never clear.

scored.title: Scored
scored.description: True when the newest run that measured the company stored a signal for it. False for a company no run has measured, and for one the newest run measured but could not score — even when an older signal exists (see latest_as_of).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: scored: in the latest run. not_in_latest_run: scored, but the latest run did not measure it, so its score is older. below_coverage_floor: measured, but too little of the model's weight had data. missing_fundamentals: below the floor because no annual results were stored. sector_not_supported: below the floor because its results filings (banks, insurers) carry no figures the model's annual statements can be built from. never_scored: no run has measured it.

latest_as_of.title: Latest As Of
latest_as_of.description: Newest date with a signal row; null when there is none. Older than measured_as_of when a later run could not score it.

measured_as_of.title: Measured As Of
measured_as_of.description: The run the reason, coverage and factor counts describe: the newest date any run stored anything for the company.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Fraction (0-1) of the model's weight backed by data on measured_as_of. Null when no run has measured the company.

coverage_floor.title: Coverage Floor
coverage_floor.description: Coverage below which the current model withholds a score, as a fraction (0-1). Older signals may have been stored under another floor; their model_version says which.

factors_measured.title: Factors Measured
factors_measured.description: Factors with a sector z-score on measured_as_of. Null when no factor rows were stored for that date.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: One plain sentence for display, stating the measured share and what was missing.

ScoreStatusOut.title: ScoreStatusOut
ScoreStatusOut.description: Whether a company has a score and, when it does not, why.

scored.title: Scored
scored.description: Instruments with a signal that day.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.description: Instruments listed and not delisted that day; one with no listing date counts as listed.

bse_code.title: Bse Code
bse_code.description: BSE scrip code, as the company's own results filings identify it. Null until a filing has been read.

listing_date.title: Listing Date
listing_date.description: Null: no source for it is ingested yet.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: The exchange's industry classification. For the NIFTY 100 universe today it repeats the sector.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: Date of the newest signal; null when none is stored. It may be older than /health.latest_as_of — see /score-status.

SearchResultOut.title: SearchResultOut
SearchResultOut.description: A search match with its newest score, for the autocomplete's score chip.

disclosed_date.title: Disclosed Date
disclosed_date.description: When the pattern became public — its knowledge date. See disclosed_date_source for whether it was observed or assumed.

disclosed_date_source.title: Disclosed Date Source
disclosed_date_source.description: NSE: the exchange's own disclosure date. ASSUMED_LODR_DEADLINE: not reported, so the regulatory deadline (21 days after quarter end) stands in for it.

promoter_pct.title: Promoter Pct
promoter_pct.description: Percent of total shares, 0-100 (not a fraction).

promoter_pledged_pct.title: Promoter Pledged Pct
promoter_pledged_pct.description: Pledged shares as a percent of the promoter holding. Null means unknown — the shareholding feed carries no pledge figure — never zero pledged.

fii_pct.title: Fii Pct
fii_pct.description: Percent of total shares, 0-100 (not a fraction). Null where the source did not break it out.

dii_pct.title: Dii Pct
dii_pct.description: Percent of total shares, 0-100 (not a fraction). Null where the source did not break it out.

public_pct.title: Public Pct
public_pct.description: Percent of total shares, 0-100 (not a fraction).

employee_trust_pct.title: Employee Trust Pct
employee_trust_pct.description: Percent of total shares, 0-100 (not a fraction).

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Fraction (0-1) of the model's weight backed by data — weighted by family and by each factor's weight within its family, so not a share of factors (score-status gives the factor counts). Below /model.coverage_floor no score is published.

previous.description: The same instrument's most recent signal strictly before this row's as_of, whatever the rows a query returns; null for its first. A different model_version means the change is partly the model's.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Fraction (0-1) of the model's weight backed by data — weighted by family and by each factor's weight within its family, so not a share of factors (score-status gives the factor counts). Below /model.coverage_floor no score is published.

previous.description: The same instrument's most recent signal strictly before this row's as_of, whatever the rows a query returns; null for its first. A different model_version means the change is partly the model's.
